CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   B. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   B. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   B. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   B. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   C. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   D. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Feeding the four thousand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the Paralysed Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the Lost Sheep and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich Young Ruler 3 3.9 A Friend at Midnight 3 Page 12 of 87 xii 4.0 The Chur and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Feeding the four thousand; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
